summary: 100-foot Aermotor fire tower on Horseblock Mountain, Talladega National Forest, Cleburne County; NHLR-registered 2022; build year unknown, photo dated 1948; 1976 bomb incident; USFS.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR detail page is the only substantive source and it gives no build year and no status, access or staffing details. The Forest Lookouts page repeats the 1976 Decatur Daily quote and adds only the county and national forest. The Commons category gives four photos dated 2024-11-17; the photo titles suggest missing stair steps and a jeep trail, and no source says whether the tower is open to visitors. The brief's record checks out against NHLR (coordinates, elevation 1,402 ft = 427 m, USFS, 2022 registration), so no corrections. The 1976 victim is not named in the story. No photos added to the photos array: Commons files were not checked for license. Not verified: current condition and whether the tower is closed. A search snippet lists an Abel Horseblock Lookout Tower on Natural Atlas and anyplaceamerica.com; it may be the same tower under another name, but was not fetched and is not cited. The USFS Talladega recreation map PDF had no extractable text.
